description: Register a new API key against a USDC payment the caller has already sent (no auth required, no email). This tool does not move funds: it submits the transaction hash and a signature from the wallet that sent the payment. Paid in USDC only, on Ethereum, Optimism, BNB Chain, Polygon, Base, Arbitrum, Avalanche or Solana. Receiving addresses: 0xee432065474D2C852700f74e3fD81e2Bcc16a3D4 on Ethereum, Optimism, Polygon, Base, Arbitrum or Avalanche; 0xAd982CB19aCCa2923Df8F687C0614a7700255a23 on BNB Chain (USDC sent to it on the other EVM chains is also accepted during the changeover); 8fyEGM5tRjMocKQWaVXyM2XvvnTxR3sWdrYtug2zeLX4 on Solana (USDC sent to 6a1mLjefhvSJX1sEX8PTnionbE9DqoYjU6F6bNkT4Ydr is also accepted during the changeover). USDT, any other token and any other chain are refused and not credited. The sending wallet becomes the key's wallet: one key per wallet, and an existing key is topped up with a credit purchase instead. Non-refundable. Current prices and volume discounts: https://insumermodel.com/pricing/

appName.description: Name for the API key (e.g. your agent or app name)

chainId.description: Chain where the USDC was sent: Ethereum (1), Optimism (10), BNB Chain (56), Polygon (137), Base (8453), Arbitrum (42161), Avalanche (43114), or 'solana'. Purchases are paid in USDC only.

senderSignature.description: Required. The wallet that sent the payment signs this exact text, five lines joined by \n with no trailing newline: "api.insumermodel.com", "Confirm the wallet that sent this payment.", "Purpose: key purchase", "Chain: eip155:<chainId>" (or "Chain: solana"), "Transaction: <transaction hash>" (EVM as 0x plus lowercase hex, Solana as given). When the signature is required, a call without it returns the exact text in a 400 and the payment is not used. EVM: personal_sign (EIP-191), 0x hex; a smart wallet is checked with ERC-1271. Solana: signMessage (ed25519), base58 or base64. A 403 means the signature is not from the wallet that sent the payment; a 503 means a smart-wallet check could not complete and the payment was not used, so retry.
